units.source_text: 参观金阁的游人逐渐增多。

en.t: The number of visitors coming to see the Golden Pavilion gradually increased.

units.source_text: 为对付通货膨胀，老师向市政府提出申请增加参观费，获得了批准。

en.t: To cope with inflation, the teacher applied to the city government to raise the admission fee, and the request was approved.
